title: DesignBrief
description:
The design brief. Every field has a default, so a partial draft from
the agent loads and the user fills the rest.

accessibility_constraints.description: Accessibility needs, such as `WCAG AA contrast`.

answers.description: The answers the user gave, newest last.

assumptions.description:
Choices the app or the agent made without the user. Use only
where a confirmed fact does not cover the need.

brand_assets.description: Logos, colors, fonts, and files the design must use.

confirmed_facts.description: Facts the user stated or confirmed. Never guessed.

generation_instructions.description:
Instructions for the generation run, newest last. Critiques
append here.

information_architecture.description: The screens or sections in order, one line each.

primary_job.description: The one thing a user must be able to do.

request.description: The user's request, in their words.

required_sections.description: The screens or sections that must exist, with their content.

revision.description: The revision number of this brief, from 1.

revision_history.description: Every revision so far, oldest first.

success_criterion.description: How the team knows the design worked, such as `sign-up rate`.

target_artifact.description: What to make, such as `landing page` or `onboarding flow`.

target_platform.description: Where it runs, such as `desktop web` or `iOS app`.

technical_constraints.description: Technical limits, such as `no external fonts`.

BriefRevision.description: One entry in a brief's revision history.

at.description: When it was made, as an RFC 3339 UTC string.

summary.description: One line that says what changed.

BriefSection.description: One required screen or section of the artifact.

name.description: The section name, such as `Hero` or `Pricing`.

QuestionAnswer.description: The user's answer to one question.

other_text.description: The text of the `Other` choice, when the user chose it.

question_id.description: The id of the question answered.

skipped.description:
True when the user chose `Use your best judgment`. The app
records the question as an assumption.

values.description: The chosen option values, or the text for a text question.

RevisionSource.description: Who or what made a brief revision.

oneOf.description: The briefing agent drafted or updated it.
The user edited it in the brief panel.
The app moved open questions into assumptions.
